answer_1.quote: we conduct experiments on two text-generation tasks: style transfer and conditional generation.
answer_1.outputs: sentences generated through style transfer and conditional generation

answer_2.quote: To measure generation quality for both tasks, we test the following metrics: Style Preservation: Following previous work , we pre-train a style classifier and use it to test whether a generated sentence can be categorized into the correct target style class. Content Preservation: For style transfer, we measure whether a generation preserves the content information from the original sentence by the self-BLEU score . Generation Quality: To measure the generation quality, we calculate the corpus-level BLEU score between a generated sentence and the testing data corpus.

answer_4.quote: Besides the automatic evaluation metrics mentioned above, we further test our disentangled representation effectiveness by human evaluation. ... The generated sentences are manually evaluated on style accuracy (SA), content preservation (CP), and sentence fluency (SF).
answer_4.guideline: The generated sentences are manually evaluated on style accuracy (SA), content preservation (CP), and sentence fluency (SF). The CP and SF scores are between 0 to 5.
